children: C3.ai reported fiscal first quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with total revenue of $52.4 million and positive free cash flow of $2.1 million. The company recorded a GAAP net loss per share of $(0.60) and a non-GAAP net loss per share of $(0.20), while non-GAAP loss from operations narrowed to $(36.2) million. Management highlighted a 73% quarter-over-quarter increase in bookings, a cash balance of $651.1 million, and ongoing execution of its turnaround plan.
Total revenue: $52.4 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
GAAP gross profit: $16.7 million (32% gross margin); Non-GAAP gross profit: $26.1 million (50% non-GAAP gross margin).
GAAP net loss: $(92.8) million; GAAP net loss per share: $(0.60).
Non-GAAP net loss: $(30.7) million; Non-GAAP net loss per share: $(0.20).
Net cash provided by operating activities / Free cash flow: $2.1 million; Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities: $651.1 million.
Bookings increased 73% quarter over quarter, supporting management's turnaround progress.
Closed 22 agreements during the quarter, including customers across manufacturing, automotive, healthcare and federal agencies.
Subscription revenue constituted 94% of total revenue, reflecting continued SaaS mix in revenue composition.
Company executed sales restructuring, instituted expense controls and added experienced leadership to drive stabilization and operational discipline.
Forrester Research named C3.ai a leader in Enterprise AI, underscoring market positioning and product recognition.
